publishedfiledetails.title: Advanced World Generation
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
[h1][b]END OF DEVELOPMENT AND GOODBYE[/b][/h1]
I have stopped the development of this and future mods. 
More information can be found on the link below. 
[url=data.ewul.net/dlc/Game/DST/goodbye.html]Goodbye[/url].

[h1][b]MAIN FEATURES:[/b][/h1]
Introduces "Infuse Worlds" feature which brings Cave content above ground mixed with normal biomes. By default there will be no darkness in such a world (except in the night time of course). If you want darkness, you can combine "Infuse Worlds" with "Day" World Generation option by setting it to "Only Night". When using it with "Only Night" game option make sure to enable the "Lights Out Mod Starting Items" so that the player spawns in with a Lantern and a bit of fuel for it to get the adventure started.
When the option is enabled, then there is no need to create a separate cave world server instance.
(Due to game limitations, the "labyrinth" biome is not found when using Infused Worlds feature, because that results the biome textures to become invisible)

Introduces existing and not yet included Set Pieces into the game world. Each Set Piece can also be enabled or disabled and the amount placed in the world is configurable. (Don't be suprised if not all your Set Pieces get added to the world which you configured previously. This is due to the problem of the world generation itself and sometimes the world can't find a free spot for the Set Piece)

You can set multiple Giants spawn locations which means multiple Giants can spawn into the world.

Enables the world size to go beyond normal limits, in other words, colossal sizes. (Be aware that huge map sizes require powerful servers and map generation might require multiple tries in order for the World Generation algorithm not to hit the "Infinite Edge" which causes the map generation to fail)

Can add Nightmare Phase to Overworld.

[h1][b]IMPORTANT NOTES:[/b][/h1]
The mod must be enabled during the start of a new world generation step. When enabled on an already created world, the mod does nothing.
When the mod gets bigger updates then the world reset is ONLY required if you want to have the new updates in your world, otherwise the world is just fine and players can keep playing in it normally without problems.
When generating a new world: 

1) Dedicated Server: Place "worldgenoverride.lua" in Servers Data Store location. This is the path where all the world and player data is stored. There are also files like "server_chat_log.txt", "server_log.txt" and "server.ini" in that location. This is the directory which you can set yourself via the command line parameter so it's different on different machines and setups, but the default should be located at ".\My Documents\Klei\DoNotStarveTogether\". Although do note that this is also the same location where the files can be found on server hosted from inside the game, so make sure if you have set the location yourself or use the default location.
You can get a documented copy of said file from here [url=data.ewul.net/dlc/game/dst/lua/worldgenoverride.lua.txt]WorldGenOverride[/url]
You can replace "default" values with any valid values provided inside the sample "worldgenoverride.lua" file.
Simply copy the content from the link to a file placed in the correct location and named "worldgenoverride.lua", then change the default values to your liking or leave them default.
After all that is done, simply run your dedicated server, wait for a bit and everything should be working fine. Please note that this only works when the world is freshly generated, applying this method to already generated world does nothing to the server.
If you want to enable the Infused World option, you have to change the "preset" value to "INFUSED" and "task_set" value to "infused" in worldgenoverride.

2) Server Hosted from inside the game: You can change any values you want from the "World" settings. 
If you want to enable the Infused World option then first enable the mod and then go to "World" tab and change the Forest Presets to "Infused".

[i]If you are using "modoverrides.lua", here is an example configuration which you can simply copy/paste to yours and change values if needed so you don't have to manually write all the settings parameters yourself: 
(If you use other mods as well, simply add this part into the existing "modoverrides.lua" you have)
[url=data.ewul.net/dlc/game/dst/lua/modoverrides_advanced_world_generation_and_cave_content.lua.txt]Modoverrides for Advanced World Generation[/url] 
Please note that the example "modoverrides.lua" uses default values of the mod. If you want to change something, go under mods install directory, open up "modinfo.lua" and check the correct configuration number values from there and then apply them to your "modoverrides.lua".[/i]

This mod is incompatible with the following mods: "The Order Is Given" (The mod has not been updated a long time), "Tungsten Mod" (Causes invisible walls).
The world size should be set to "Huge" when encountering errors when generating worlds according to few user reports who used this method and it helped. (There was and still might be a bug from Klei which messes with mods and world generation on certain world sizes, so just use "Huge" to be safe)

[h1][b]SIDE NOTES:[/b][/h1]
Some features are planned for the future as well, these I will implement when i have more time.
If you have recommendations to the mod, leave a comment down below.

Recommended mods to use together with this mod:
[url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=597417408]Less Lags[/url] - Mod that makes all the servers capable of running infinite number of days without getting laggy from all the prefabs that get generated in long running servers. When the mod is configured correctly it periodically deletes some or all prefabs (items, monsters, animals etc) from the entire world and keeps it lag free.

[url=steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=758921911]Increase Animals[/url] - Mod which adds in even more Set Pieces and you can tweak the number of animals/monsters in the world.

[h1][b]BUG REPORTING:[/b][/h1]
Add all your bug reports under "Discussions" > "Bug Reports". (To avoid Comment section cluttering)
Also a great help is if you can upload your crash log "log.txt" to [url=pastebin.com/]PasteBin[/url] and link me the crash log that way in the bug section with a description what did you do before the crash occured.

[h1][b]LIVE CHAT:[/b][/h1]
If you wish to talk to Me or other players or users of this Mod, you can join us on Live chat where we can discuss problems, ask questions or simply chat about random things.
Join here and proceed to "Gaming" room: [url=im.ewul.net/public/]EWUL Public Chat[/url]

生命值：150（+34.5）
san值：200

防御系数：0

人物物品
初始根据皮肤不同带有皮肤不同的帽子与武器。

头部装备，无耐久
初始40%减伤，给予木甲/影甲/铥矿护甲分别可以使减伤提升至50%/60%/70%

手部装备，无耐久，攻击速度略慢
攻击力：51/59.5/68/100（可在模组配置界面修改）
攻击距离：1
不会因为潮湿而脱手。
可通过给予武器不同的宝石解锁不同的技能。（旧版本特性，现版本不需要了）
技能详见技能介绍。

护符，最高可升级至三级。
配方：4绝望石+2电子元件+8金块/一级唱片收藏箱+4绝望石+3红宝石+10金块/二级唱片收藏箱+4绝望石+4彩虹宝石+12金块
属性：
生命值上限+50/65/90（不受人物特性的加成）
攻击系数+0.2/0.3/0.5
防御系数：0/20%/50%
特效：
替身基础伤害提升至23/34.5/46
减速效果提升至40%/50%/60%
4.未竟之美：
护符，最高可升级至三级。
配方：4绝望石+2大理石+8金块/一级唱片收藏箱+4绝望石+3红宝石+10金块/二级唱片收藏箱+4绝望石+4彩虹宝石+12金块
属性：
san值上限+100/200/300
攻击系数+0.1/0.2/0.35
防御系数：15%/35%/70%
特效：
san值吸收伤害比例提升至60%/67%/75%
替身移动速度提升至：4/5/6
5.唱片：
武器，无耐久，较慢的攻速但是较高的伤害（可配置）

详见游戏内
月光阵营：（对暗影加伤10%）
来自月光的抚慰让你更加强壮
受到的伤害降低，降低的比例随月相变化，满月时达到最低0%，新月时达到最高30%（目前减伤因为未知原因没生效）

Seele Vollerei

From mobile game [guns girlZ]

She’s a girl from orphanage, who loves fairy tales and her sister Bronya.
A scary experiment quantized her, and drive her away from the world. 
Then ,she came to the world of don’t starve together. She has to live on.



About the character:
Seele can get experience by killing monsters, reading books and killing boss.
Raising her level would increase her hunger, health ,sanity and attack.
When her level is higher than 10,  reading books wouldn’t give her experience.
When her level is higher than 20,  killing monsters wouldn’t give her experience.
Her highest level is 30.


Seele has three states, but she’s blocked in [normal Seele] state in the first two days.

Quantum Seele:
Seele become mysterious, which means she could neither attack other creatures nor use tools. She couldn’t even make anything by herself.
However, in this state, Seele could move quite fast and could see at night. She could also read books.

Normal Seele:
This is how Seele really should be. She loves the world, she would make everyone around her increase sanity.  She hate killing small animals. She loves reading books.

Killer Seele:
This is her other personality. She’s cruel, she’s powerful and swift, but being her would spend quite a lot of hunger and sanity. She hates fairy tales, so she could no longer benefit from the books.

How to change the state:
Seele is usually in the quantun state. When being chased by an enemy, or accompanied by a friend (including other player or pigmen) ,she’ll become normal state. Reading fairy tales also keep her away from quantum state for a while. I have to tell you, the last book [ball lightening] written by Liu cixin isn’t a fairy tale.
Without those help, she’ll become quantum state soon.

When seele is badly hurt (lost her health into 1/3), she’ll become the killer state. When she is will healed (her health become more than 4/5), she’ll turn back to the normal state. If she has little hunger or sanity left (less than 1/10), she ‘ll also turn back to the normal state.



When you get level 10, you’ll get the skill: Seele’s will (press Z to turn on/off)
After turning on , you’ll get a layer of ‘will’ per second. Each layer will increase your attack and decrease the damage you suffer. However, it’ll also spend you more hunger.
Each time you are hurt, the layer would be divided by half.
If you get more than 20 layers, you won’t lost sanity for fear of the night or the monsters.


When you get level 15, you’ll get the skill: Seele’s harmony (press X to turn on/off)
After turning on, you’ll spend other weapon instead of itself when you use your reaper or you magic box. Be careful, do not waste your precious weapons (including your books) by this skill.
The skill has another usage: when you fix your weapons or clothes by the abyssal crystal or tears, your attack will increase for a will. Tears would make this last longer.


When you get level 20, you’ll get the skill: Seele’s banquet
When you are beaten by a fatal attack ,you’ll evade it, but keep losing more health in 10 seconds. During this time, you’ll get stronger and each one you killed would heal you.
This CD would cool down for a whole day after being triggered.

publishedfiledetails.file_description:
饥荒弃坑了一年多
很怀念以前和安然逗比们一起建家打怪的日子
现在版本跟新变化很大，作为回归礼物，更新以前自己用的一款主机测试MOD供大家使用
原MOD地址 http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=551338671

自由生成物品。 搜索你想要的物品和控制服务器。 7 种不同的物品标签方便使用。

使用方法：
普通：
按 T 键显示菜单。（可以在选项中更改）
CTRL + 点击菜单中生命、精神、饥饿、湿度、温度 和 伍迪的木头值按钮 将得到相反的结果。
搜索步骤：点击 "搜索你要的物品！" -> 输入搜索内容 -> Enter 键。
选择生效玩家步骤：点击调试菜单中的 "人物" 指示按钮 -> 输入玩家的序号或昵称 -> 确认。

物品生成：
单击生成 1 个物品。（可以在选项中更改）
右击生成 10 个物品。（可以在选项中更改）
SHIFT + 单击或右击得到和物品生成数量份数的制作材料。
CTRL + 点击加入或移除自定义物品列表。
自动 在你的物品栏中 或 人物旁边 生成。

搜索时的按键：
Enter 键或点击任意位置：搜索输入的内容。
UP 键：上个输入内容。
DOWN 键：下个输入内容或清空输入的内容。
ESC 键：退出输入。

说明：
客户端MOD。
无需服务器开启，开了也没用。
只有在检测到拥有主机或管理员权限时，MOD 的菜单才会出现。

物品列表： All 所有, Foods 食物, Resources 资源, Weapons 武器, Tools 工具, Clothes 穿戴, Gifts 礼物, Livings 生物, buildings 建筑和 Others 其他。
其他当前未添加入列表物品 和 MOD 物品在 Others 其他物品列表中。
仅支持在当前使用的物品列表里搜索。
搜索功能会记录搜索过的内容。（最大记录数量可以在选项中设置）

其他功能：上帝模式 || 创造模式 || 一击必杀模式 || 改变生命、精神、饥饿、湿度、温度 和 伍迪的木头刻度 || 改变 季节、时间、速度 和 天气 || 杀人 || 复活 || 清空背包 || 返回选人界面 || 召集队友 || 重启 || 换图 || 回滚 || 储存 || 地图控制 || 传送点记录读取 || 删除、施肥、催熟、收获、拾取、冻结 周围目标 || 驯化牛 || 随从控制 || 关掉服务器

可以选择命令对哪个玩家生效。（仅和你在同一个世界有效）

本 MOD 的数据是可存储的。（可以在选项中关闭）
不同的世界的传送功能数据会分开存储。（放心的存储你的位置吧！）
不支持手柄或控制器。

注意：
没有这个 MOD 你也可以用命令达到相同的作用。它只是一个图形化界面。
使用这个将会降低游戏乐趣，请不要肆意使用。
其他物品列表里的东西有可能会导致游戏崩溃。(小心使用 )


如何添加管理员：
adminlist.txt：

请你的朋友加入你的游戏。
在路径：文档/klei/don't starve together/client_save(主机 ) 或 cluster.ini 同目录(服务器 ) 下建立 adminlist.txt 并打开。
请你的朋友在游戏中按 Y 或 U 键说句话。
在文本文档文件：文档/klei/don't starve together/client_chat_log.txt 中查找玩家的 ID。（示例：KU_********(在线) / OU_12345678901234567(离线)）
复制 ID 到 adminlist.txt 并保存。(每行一个 ID)
重启服务器，就会发现添加了 ID 的朋友已是管理员。


Steam 组：

使用 Steam 组来管理服务器及管理员。 [forums.kleientertainment.com]
设置 steam_group_admins = true，并且在 steam 组中设置玩家为官员（按两次星，星变成黄金色）。
重启服务器，就会发现设置了官员的朋友已是管理员。


命令列表 [dont-starve-game.wikia.com]
中文維基 [zh.dontstarve.wikia.com]
搭建服务器教程(英文) [forums.kleientertainment.com]

鸣谢：
原作者 C.J.B.
GaRAnTuLA 修复了 BUG。
SKULL  UI 的重写，bug 的修复，增加：搜索功能、不同物品列表、丰富的其他指令。

publishedfiledetails.title: Cluster Plant. Reborn!
publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Plant things, in clusters!

What it does:

Adds recipes to the refine tab to allow for planting grass, saplings, pinecones, and berrybushes in clusters.

How to use:

After installing and launching the game, configure the Cluster Plant mod in the mods menu. Choose the grid size and secondary resource scale, hit apply and play!

In the game, hover over the recipes in the refine tab. Meet the requirements and plant away!

Note: On the secondary resource scale, the base number is the grid size (so 3x3 would be 9, 5x5 would be 25) the scale is multiplied by the base number. So a 3x3 with a 100% scale will be 1*(3*3) = 9. The result is the number of secondary resources required to craft the recipe in game.

Why this was made:

I was tired of misclicking things while planting fields of things. Also, I wanted to learn how to modify things for fun.

publishedfiledetails.file_description:
Howdy! AmaLee here to present to you a playable character mod for Don't Starve Together; Maxwell's assistant, Charlie!
(If you're not sure who Charlie is, may I perhaps persuade you to take a look at the William Carter Puzzles?)

 I currently need a ton of help adding new and exciting features for Charlie! IF YOU ARE INTERESTED IN ASSISTING WITH THE MOD, please send a message to me!

How this mod was possible:
Charlie was made with the Extended Sample Character Mod provided by Dleowolf!
TheDanaAddams' tutorial was also a big help in some of the scripting processes that need to be done to get her perks to work.
The text for her name in her big portrait for DST was graciously given by Jeff Agala over on tumblr.
A huge thanks to The Noon Fish and Dryicefox for helping me with her ghost and sounds!

Basic information on the mod:
Charlie's character design was based on the designs seen in 8th William Carter Puzzle. Currently, she has two different "perks": her sanity is drained at a higher rate (x1.25), she has a lower maximum health (113) and her damage updates depending on the time of day. Currently, the rates are as follows:
Day: x1
Dusk: x1.5
Night: x2
This should apply to all equippable weapons, as well as unarmed damage.

IF YOU'RE INTERESTED IN CHARLIE'S CUSTOM SOUND: Currently, steam workshop has a problem with custom characters that have custom sound. When uploaded, the mod will not be added into the mod lists of players who have subscribed to said mod. For this reason, Charlie's custom sound addition will ONLY be available for download at the forums, found here: http://forums.kleientertainment.com/files/file/1099-charlie-a-playable-character-mod-rog-and-dst-compatible/
I apologize for this inconvenience, however I have not found a solution otherwise.
PLEASE MAKE SURE EVERYONE IN YOUR PARTY HAS THE SAME VERSION OF THE MOD (sound/soundless), OTHERWISE SHE MAY NOT BE PLAYABLE.

Thank you for checking out my mod! May all of your adventures be gruesome, and if you have any suggestions, please visit the discussion board!
